report.value: The page states a chip select held high through a coprocessor reset (Pins.md:151-155: external pull-up of about 10 kOhm, pad pull-down 32 to 86 kOhm). With the host rail up, the input sits at 2.51 to 2.96 V, above the isolator's 2.31 V threshold (0.7 x 3.3 V), and an F part's output follows its input. The F default (low) acts only when the input side is unpowered or the input open. No line of Pins.md, IOBoard.md or Research.md states the host side unpowered while the pack side runs; P2's 'unpowered' wording is not in the cited lines. Four F rows qualify and rank below their default-high twins. If the owner states that case, ranks 3, 4, 6 and 7 fail: with the 3.3 V rail down and the 5 V supply up they hold CSB, SCK and SDI at 0 V, and SCK - CSB is 0 mV, so no wake pulse
report.source: checkout 7e74cd442a79 hardware/docs/Pins.md:151-155; SLLSEP4K 7.4 Table 7-2 and 5.15/5.16 tDO (read 2026-10-03T11:20:34Z); SLLSFJ6G 9.4 Table 9-2

report.value: ISO7741 with the F suffix needs 3.2 us typ / 8.5 us max (3.3 V) and 3 / 8.5 us (5 V) from enable to a high output on a high-impedance pin (tPZH); the non-F part needs 14 / 30 ns to a high output but 2.5 / 8.5 us to a low one. If EN1 gates the reverse channel by chip select, the first SDO bit is valid 8.5 us after CS falls for an F part. ADBMS1818 t7 (CSB falling to SCK rising) is 1 us min

report.value: Pins.md puts the ADS1235, MAX31856 and the ADBMS1818 on the one SPI1 and says SPI1_RX 'reaches the cell monitor only across the barrier'. P2's pin account has the isolator's enables tied high, so the reverse output drives SPI1_RX all the time, against the MISO outputs of the ADS1235 and MAX31856 when those are selected. ISO7741 and ISO6741 EN1 (pin 7), and ADuM5411 VE1 (pin 7), put that output in high impedance; EN1 is active high and CS is active low, so the drive needs an inverter or a pin the budget does not hold. ADuM3151's MI has no enable. No page states a tri-state requirement; the check is listed for P5 and not applied as a pass or fail
